## Notes

Release 2004, developer Steve Walmsley, PC, free to download. Turn-based science fiction 4X; time advances in steps from 5 seconds to 30 days; eleven Trans-Newtonian Elements with accessibility 0.1 to 1; jump points found by survey; colony cost from gravity, atmosphere, temperature, lowered by terraforming; ship classes designed from components; missiles versus beams; scientists, administrators, naval officers, ground commanders improve over time.
